title: NordVPN: 100% Cashback for New Customers @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: NordVPN: 100% Cashback for New Customers @ TopCashback AU

[bin555] remember to factor in exchange rate. Its not a 100%.
[geegee2u] so how does this work exactly? you sign up for a 2 year plan and pretty much its all returned except the GST?
[suziegel] Choose a country with NO GST/VAT/Tax e.g. Christmas Island. GST is ineligible for cashback when Australia is chosen (default country).
[plain_biscuit] does appending "." or "+" to gmail count as new account?
[senorclean] It has for me in the past eg me+nord2026@gmail.com
[MeesusEff] Is there a limit to how many I can buy on the same TCB acc? Forgot to change the country so submitted the cancellation request and was going to sign up a new email after
[TaurusHead] (3) A new click/tap from TopCashback's 'Get cashback' button must be generated with each new order from NordVPN. Failure to do so will cause all cashback on subsequent orders to be declined by NordVPN.
